statement: The client has a dynamic risk profile (risk class 4) with a 15-year investment horizon, a growth objective, and a high capacity to bear losses, while having no short-term liquidity needs. The proposed portfolio is suitable for this profile as its funds align appropriately with the client's risk tolerance. Specifically, the portfolio includes iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF USD Acc and iShares Core MSCI EM IMI UCITS ETF USD Acc (both with an SRI of 4), Carmignac Patrimoine A EUR Acc (SRI of 3), and iShares € High Yield Corp Bond UCITS ETF EUR Dist (SRI of 2). The client does not require liquidity in the next two years. Draft for advisor review and signature.
